Hana (marketing): Quick alignment: aiming to flip the release signal Friday 10:00 PT. Need canonical docs URL, changelog blurb, webinar CTA, and lead-steering plan.
Omar (eng): Canary will start 07:45 PT in zone-a, staggered across zones until 10:15 PT. Promote if error rate <0.5% and p95 latency within expected band.
Lucy (docs): Draft canonical page is at https://redwood.docs/drafts/176777 - I'll publish Thu EOD and add redirects.
Priya (product): Webinar scheduled Tue 11 PT (demo + roadmap). Marketing copy should call out latency uplift and the Dedicated rollout.
Hana (marketing): For headline options: "Launch-ready inference: faster, cheaper, more reliable" OR "Inference that scales with uptime guarantees" — pick a direction?
Miguel (analytics): Public-friendly benchmark: median 108ms, p95 225ms (seq=256). Token cost ~18% lower with prefix caching. I'll attach the snapshot and brief methodology note.
Omar (eng): Note: under heavy non-SLA load we route best-effort traffic to a quantized variant. Keep wording high-level: "availability-preserving fallbacks". Ops will document the header toggles.
Lucy (docs): Adding Operational Notes appendix with sample header `X-Redwood-Fallback: on|off` and an internal link to the benchmark methodology.
Hana (marketing): Inbound routing plan: use `?utm_source=launch_wheel` and add `launch_tag=april_signal` in HubSpot. Miguel to create the lead segment and assign follow-up owner.
Miguel (analytics): Will create HubSpot segment and add attribute `announce_origin: launch_wheel`. Routing rule: high-touch leads -> PM team, others -> self-serve nurture.
Priya (product): Can we include a light A/B test in the email subject lines? I'll coordinate with Hana on variant copy.
Hana (marketing): Yes. T+0 social + blog, T+15m email to trials, T+45m press outreach. Webinar reminders: 48h and 2h.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary -> prod/zone-a at 2026-04-24T07:45:00Z (staggered) 4; status: queued.
Omar (eng): Action item for docs: include a small footnote linking to internal reproducibility notes so we don't get pulled on methodology. Lucy?
Lucy (docs): Will add footnote: internal link to `/benchmarks/method-176777` and a short note on variance. Canonical docs URL will be final by Thu EOD.
Hana (marketing): Owners recap: Hana = announce copy + social; Lucy = docs + changelog; Omar/ops = rollout; Miguel = metrics + lead segments; Priya = webinar. I'll lock announce copy Wed noon.
Omar (eng): One more: if marketing quotes the memory-fix in public changelog, include the issue number and brief context to reduce follow-ups.
Hana (marketing): Got it. We'll include the fix note with ticket #3421 and the brief one-liner.
Miguel (analytics): Posting final dashboard snapshot to the announce doc by 5pm PT today.
Hana (marketing): Great. If no objections, I'll paste the final links here when live and close the loop. :rocket:
Priya (product): All good from product.
Lucy (docs): Docs OK from me.
Omar (eng): No objections from eng. :+1:
